summary: This 8-K reports a company-issued equity financing, not a special situation in the classic event-driven sense. On October 14, 2026, Verastem, Inc. entered an underwriting agreement with Jefferies LLC and Guggenheim Securities, LLC for an underwritten offering of 30,937,500 common shares at $8.00 per share and 312,503 pre-funded warrants at $7.9999. Net proceeds are approximately $234.7 million, expected to close on or about October 15, 2026. No price/share, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is named. Risk-arb angle is limited; monitor dilution and pricing versus market.
